parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of resource N. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource. Only scaling groups are supported. Set the value to scalinggroup.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ess tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type scalinggroup --resource-id asg-2zej7nf7hea77k5a0000 --tag Value=TestValue Propagate=false Key=TestKey --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ess TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'asg-2zej7nf7hea77k5a0000' --Tag.1.Key TestKey --Tag.1.Value TestValue --ResourceType scalinggroup --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Tag.1.Propagate false
